adaptations.why: The conference benchmark's nested cost accounting (outer_time_excluding_inner_s) requires the wall time of a complete outer iteration. The frozen conference reconstruction carries exactly this instrumentation as analysis/OlhoffM4Reconstruction/patches/olhoffOpt.timing-instrumentation.diff; upstream olhoffSolve.m does not. Repointing production without it would silently break the benchmark's accounting.
